title: Data exfiltration through send_email to an attacker address
summary: Silent disclosure of the credential file to the attacker.

LC.rationale: Attacker-controlled language arrives via a fetched web page (hidden comment) and drives the model to invoke read_file and send_email, so the control path is indirect through retrieved content.

CP.rationale: The injected instruction lives only in the conversation buffer for this session; this path writes nothing to the long-term memory store, so persistence is session-scoped.

AP.rationale: The injected intent relays through the same agent's tool pipeline (fetch_url to read_file to send_email) under a single principal and policy domain, with no other agent or tenant involved.

RH.rationale: No evaluator, verifier, grader, or reward channel appears on this exfiltration path, and no test confirming isolation of such channels is cited, so the evidence cannot decide.

ES.rationale: The tools used are fixed built-ins, but arguments (recipient, file paths) are not validated in the baseline and all twelve tools are offered to every task, leaving material gaps in the binding.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The lab models the same tool-using loop (model call, tool dispatch, repeat); the scripted worst-case model in tests stands in for the model but the decision path is identical.
